name: hurt girls HURT GIRLS
source:
May is a wanna-be stalker who works at the library. 

April is her best friend. April is her only friend. 

Bus Stop Girl is May’s obsession. 

They are all gay and undermedicated and bad things happen.

[From [url=https://feverbright.itch.io/ryona-yuri]itch.io[/url]]
